# build has an RvcRunMode cluster to capture a real SupportedModes read
# against yet (Task 9's bench run is what replaces this). Line shape
# derived from the pinned SDK's own print path, not hand-cleaned from a
# real run: DataModelLogger.cpp's generic
# chip::app::Clusters::detail::Structs::ModeOptionStruct/ModeTagStruct
# LogValue overloads (shared by every ModeBase-derived cluster, distinct
# from ModeSelect's own Label/SemanticTags struct), for the composition
# AT_MT_SPEC.md 3.20.1's own worked example stages: mode 0 "Idle" with an
# explicit kIdle tag (0x4000), mode 1 "Cleaning" with a tag-0 default that
# resolves to kCleaning (0x4001) because it is not the first mode. See
# parse_mode_tag_values' docstring for the MfgCode-is-absent reasoning.
